correctness.rationale: In characteristic 5 the original sextic is identically F_t(x(x-1)), with F_t(z)=t(t-1)z^3+(1-2t)z^2+2t(1-t)z+t^2. Involutions (x,y)->(1-x,y) and its hyperelliptic product give smooth elliptic quotients Y^2=F_t(z), V^2=(4z+1)F_t(z), with separable degree-2 quotient maps and (2,2)-isogenous Jacobian. Independent exact F5[t,x,z] coefficient extraction verifies Hasse factors (t^2+2)(t^2-2t-2) and (t-2)(t+1)(t^2+2), and genus-two Cartier/Hasse-Witt matrix [[(t-2)(t+1)(t^2+2),-2t(t^2+2)],[0,(t^2+2)(t^2-2t-2)]]. The common two roots have rank zero, a-number 2, p-rank 0, hence superspecial; four other distinct roots have rank and p-rank 1; elsewhere ordinary. Pairwise gcds and the original source prove none of the six lie on excluded singular fibres t=0,1,3,infinity. Geometric counts, not F5-rational parameter counts.
